transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Thanks for seeing me. Um, I guess what finally made me come in is that I keep making these small, kind of embarrassing mistakes. Like, I'll turn in applications or research notes and later realize I mislabeled an artwork date, or I just completely skipped a question somewhere. And the frustrating part is that I honestly thought I had checked them over before turning them in. It's just been happening a lot lately.
Were you like this with careless mistakes and missed details when you were a child, too?

Yeah, actually, I was. Even back in elementary school, my teachers would write notes saying that I had good ideas, but I was always forgetting to turn in my worksheets. Or I'd lose the instructions for assignments and just miss little details. Honestly, it was like that unless my parents went through and checked my backpack every single night to make sure I had everything.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, most days, about different things?

Um, not really. I mean, I get frustrated when I realize I've messed up an application or missed something, but... I wouldn't say I'm a worrier in general. I don't really spend most days stressing about different things. I'm usually pretty relaxed, honestly.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day?
No, I haven't really been feeling down or depressed. I mean, it's annoying when I mess up my work, but it doesn't make me feel sad or anything like that. My mood is generally fine.
Do these kinds of attention and organization problems happen in more than one part of your life, such as at work or school and also at home or in other activities?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed if it happens in a bunch of different areas. I mean, I know it happens with my applications and just managing my own stuff at home, but... yeah, I don't really know if it affects other activities. I haven't really thought about it beyond that.
Before you were 12 years old, did you already have these kinds of attention or organization problems?

Yeah, I did. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers used to write that I had good ideas, but I was always forgetting to turn in my worksheets. I'd lose instructions or just miss little details all the time. It was pretty much a constant thing unless my parents went through and checked my backpack every single night to make sure I had everything. So, yeah, it's definitely been happening since I was a kid.
In the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day nearly every day?
No, like I mentioned a minute ago, I haven't felt depressed or hopeless at all. My mood has been completely fine.
